demo.title: Live demo
demo.description: The real widget on a simulated backend. Open the chat and go through the whole flow.
demo.simulated: Everything here runs in your browser: no email is sent and nothing reaches Telegram. The email is verified by itself after a moment and every message gets an automatic reply.

try.open: Open the round button in the bottom-right corner and identify yourself: name and email.
try.email: Enter any email and pick “I want to hire you” or “Another question”.
try.verify: In your app, the visitor opens the link in their email; here it is verified by itself.
try.reply: Write a message: in your app it reaches your Telegram, and your reply shows up here.

demo.reply: 👋 This is a simulated reply. In your app, it's what you write in Telegram.
